title: Rob Gronkowski elected to the Patriots Hall of Fame

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rob Gronkowski elected to the Patriots Hall of Fame
sources.description: Rob Gronkowski will be eligible for election to the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 2027, but he won't have to wait that long to be inducted into one of his former team's version.
